# Verify an aborted compaction leaves source state and temporary-file inventory intact

The current abort test starts compaction, signals the test shutdown topic before yielding and expects NS_ERROR_ABORT. It checks unchanged mbox length, preserved expungedBytes, exactly the original folder filenames, no success metric and one abort metric. The production completion callback installs DB changes only on success, closes the DB and final cleanup releases resources. This source evidence supports a rollback contract, not a crash-proof atomicity guarantee or executed abort result. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.

Scope: mailnews/base/test.
